nodes.name: Get My Resume
nodes.notes: Reads your resume text from Google Sheets.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gpt-4o-mini", temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: "json_object" }, messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are a precise job-matching analyst. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences." }, { role: "user", content: "Score how well this job fits the candidate.

CANDIDATE RESUME:
" + $json.resume_text + "

JOB:
Title: " + $json.title + "
Company: " + $json.company + "
Location: " + $json.location + "
Description: " + $json.description + "

Score the job 0-100 using EXACTLY this rubric:
- Stack match (n8n, Python, OpenAI/Claude/Gemini, APIs, automation, RAG): 40 points max
- Remote-anywhere AND accepts any nationality (no US-only, no relocation): 25 points max
- Realistic experience level for YOUR_EXPERIENCE_LEVEL (e.g. ~1 year experience) (not senior/8+ years): 20 points max
- No blocker requirements (no TensorFlow/PyTorch core, no hard Masters required, no clearance): 15 points max

Also detect RED FLAGS: staffing-agency post, vague talent pool, unpaid role, MLM-style.

Return this exact JSON shape: {"score": <integer 0-100>, "stack_match": "<1 sentence>", "location_ok": <true or false>, "experience_fit": "<1 sentence>", "blockers": "<none or what>", "has_red_flags": <true or false -- true ONLY for staffing-agency posts, vague talent pools, unpaid roles, or MLM-style listings>, "red_flags": "<empty string if has_red_flags is false, otherwise a 1 sentence description>", "verdict": "<2 sentence summary>"}" } ] }) }}

nodes.name: OpenAI Deep Scoring
nodes.notes: Uses gpt-4o-mini. All fields (job title/company/location/description + resume_text) arrive on the same item via 'Attach Resume', which merges both branches with a real input connection -- no cross-node $('Node') lookups, which are unreliable across sibling branches in n8n.

nodes.name: Send Gmail
nodes.notes: Connect your Gmail OAuth credential in n8n.

nodes.name: Attach Resume (Merge)
nodes.notes: Multiplex cross-joins every job item (Input 1, from Rule Pre-Filter) with the single resume row (Input 2, from Get My Resume), so every job item ends up carrying resume_text. Unlike a Code node with two dangling connections, Merge genuinely waits for both inputs before running.
